subject: Menger-RL kickoff — one distributed RL stack to rule them all
body:
Team,

Kicking off Menger-RL. The case: our open-source Menger work was the first distributed RL framework of its kind — scaling to a few thousand workers for data collection and inference on CPU, with pod-level accelerator training for the learner — and it was proven on real macro-placement workloads. Meanwhile our internal agents teams each maintain bespoke actor/learner plumbing. We consolidate on Menger.

Milestones (window through 07-20):
- 05-01: Menger actor fleet running on our CPU batch pool at 1,000 workers, toy environment.
- 06-05: learner integrated with our training stack; replay throughput benchmarked.
- 06-26: full-scale soak on a placement-style workload — the demo result I want for Q3 OKR planning.
- 07-17: adoption guide + first team migrated.

Bao owns staffing/compute; Leilani is TL. This one has real infra teeth — flag capacity issues early.

Ulla
